REMOVE Glen and his laptop completely, including all hair, head, torso, arms, hands, shorts, legs and shoes. Keep ONLY the existing beach umbrella, wooden pole and sand patch, at precisely the same original coordinates and scale. Reconstruct the small section of muted sage green underside of the umbrella that was hidden by his hair; extend the existing painted green panel naturally with exactly matching colour, texture and outline. Keep the umbrella shape, edge contour, segment boundaries, pole, sand and their colors exactly as the original, no restyling or repositioning. Where Glen was against empty air, leave genuine alpha transparency, not a painted backdrop. It is a clean background plate behind an animated character, so absolutely no trace, silhouette, fragment or shadow outline of the removed character. Keep the original sand's ambient shadow texture, no new dark blob. Shared style docs/art-style.md illustrated-world-v1. Exact full square composition, no crop/padding change. Actual alpha transparency outside the remaining umbrella, pole and sand.
